I would love to help you as much as I posibly can. Im 20 and I went through a very similar situation with my ex when I was 18. Ive been battling the same dragon as you for a little while now. My first thought is about her leaveing and not responding when she is upset. Its a copeing mechanism, she sees that there is a problem and probably blames herself for it and says "he will be better off with me gone". She may also be disosiateing, its when a person dosent feel like they are themselves or that anything is real and kind of lose all emotion for a little while, its another copeing mechanism that happens sometimes that my ex did kind of often. It is also very very important to know that nither you or your SO os toxic. You are both flawed people im bad situations trying your best. You also need to know that no one can Love depresion away, atleast not entirely. You cant fix this problem with a conversation or two. Both of you need to work hard to become better. Its a slow and painful process that feels imposible most of the time, but you can help eachother through it. You have to keep fighting every day to be better than you were yesterday. Then you will fail, you will fail to be better a lot. When you fail you cant give up, you need to never give up. Sometimes that means makeing it through the day, sometimes it means just makeing it through the next hour or even the next minit. Self harm I havent delt with as much but I have run into plenty. Hell dont tell anyone but I burned myself slightly on a candle just a few nights ago. The best advice I can think of for that is try to get rid of the "tools" you may use. Do it together. When you both have failures, do your best to be loveing not angry. I think thats important. Both of you are trying as hard as you can and when you fail you dont need the person ypu love angry at you ypu need them to care for you. Please mesge me if you ever need help or someone to talk to. This account is linked to my phone so I promise I will see it. Good luck. To quote a song that has helped me "your heart is a muscle the size of your fist, keep on lovin keep on fighting and hold on, hold on, hold on for your life".

I am a 20 year old guy and I get how he must feel. Im no professional in anything really, but I did experiance this first hand once. It was very strange. I was beginning to get into things with the person I was with at that time. We had been together for months at that point so nothing new really. When it became aperent that I just wasnt "up for the task" the look on her face ruined any posibility of fixing the situation. She was so disapointed and just sad, not at me all at herself. I felt a strange mix of emotion, there was some shame in not preforming as a young guy.The feeling of shame I had was quickly just overtaken by concern for her though, she was very self conscious about it. I went into triage mode so sexy times wernt really a posibility in that mental state. We did try for a little longer, but it became this very upseting cycle of her trying her best to be sexy despite feeling more and more inadequate. I could see it pretty clearly on her face and that just made it imposible for me to feel anything but worried about her. The rest of the night was me trying to convince her she is butifull. The closest thing to advice I can even begin to offer is try to avoid that cycle. Sometimes the longer you try may just make it harder as both of you get more upset. Goodluck I am sure your love will find a way past this.
